title.zh-CN: 脐血白细胞明显升高 · 生后18小时男婴
title.en: Markedly raised white count in cord blood · 18-hour-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 一名看上去状态良好的足月男婴，出生时为储存脐血所做的化验发现白细胞很高，生后不久转入新生儿病房。
summary.en: A term baby boy who looks well is moved to the neonatal unit soon after birth because the test done to store his cord blood showed a very high white count.

notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age, birth, pregnancy exposures, family history, admission signs, two blood counts, marrow morphology, immunophenotype, karyotype, multiplex RT-PCR, the change after admission, the family's withdrawal of treatment and the time of death at follow-up; they have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are hours of life or days in hospital. Which relative accompanies him, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record (haemoglobin, clotting, electrolytes, G6PD, CD10, KMT2A, CSF, the treatment given during the admission, the cause of death) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the admission film counts “lymphoblasts and prolymphocytes 95 %” while the next-day count gives “blasts 90 %”; “day 4” and “day 9” do not say whether they count days in hospital or days of life.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从极高白细胞、以原幼淋巴细胞为主的涂片、肝脾肿大和血小板减少，识别外观良好新生儿的先天性白血病，并与类白血病反应、唐氏综合征的暂时性异常骨髓造血和计数误差相鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise congenital leukaemia in a newborn who looks well from an extreme white count of immature lymphoid cells, an enlarged liver and spleen and low platelets, and tell it from a leukaemoid reaction, the transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down's syndrome and an analyser artefact.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对白细胞≥100×10⁹/L的急性淋巴细胞白血病在确诊前就开始预防肿瘤溶解（BSH 2015）：不含钾的充分水化、排除G6PD缺乏前用别嘌醇、频繁复查电解质和尿量；避免因面色差输红细胞、确诊前用激素和计划外腰穿。
learningOutcomes.en: Start tumour-lysis prevention for ALL with white cells ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L before the diagnosis is confirmed (BSH 2015) — potassium-free hydration, allopurinol until G6PD deficiency is excluded, frequent electrolytes and urine output — and avoid red cells for pallor, steroids before the diagnostic samples and an unplanned lumbar puncture.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按WHO第5版（2022）把CD19、cCD79a、CD34、HLA-DR阳性且POX阴性判读为B淋巴母细胞白血病，并说明为什么正常核型和有限的RT-PCR不能排除KMT2A重排、需要做FISH。
learningOutcomes.en: Read CD19, cCD79a, CD34 and HLA-DR with a negative POX as B-lymphoblastic leukaemia under the WHO 5th edition (2022), and explain why a normal karyotype and a limited RT-PCR panel cannot exclude KMT2A rearrangement without FISH.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么婴儿急性淋巴细胞白血病要在有经验的中心按婴儿方案治疗，并向家属说明他所属群体的机会——出生即发病者（Interfant-99，2009）和Interfant-06高危组（2019）的无事件生存都只有约五分之一——而不是全体婴儿的平均数。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why infant ALL is treated on an infant protocol at an experienced centre, and give the family the odds of his group — about one in five event-free for ALL from birth (Interfant-99, 2009) and in the Interfant-06 high-risk group (2019) — not the all-infant average.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES与新生儿父母沟通危及生命的诊断，在结局不确定时共同决策，并与姑息治疗并行计划（BAPM 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Break news of a life-threatening diagnosis to a newborn's parents with SPIKES, share the decision while the outcome is uncertain, and plan palliative care in parallel (BAPM 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把白血病新生儿的发热和反应变差按疑似晚发型败血症处理——先血培养、决定治疗后1小时内静脉抗生素（NICE NG195，2021，2024年更新）——并排查颅内出血。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat fever and reduced responsiveness in a newborn with leukaemia as suspected late-onset sepsis — blood culture, then IV antibiotics within 1 hour of deciding to treat (NICE NG195, 2021, updated 2024) — and look for intracranial bleeding.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 脐血化验白细胞很高，已经10个小时
chiefComplaint.en: His cord-blood test showed a very high white count 10 hours ago

triageNote.zh-CN: 生后18小时男婴，孕38周剖宫产，体重3.08 kg。为储存脐血所做的化验提示白细胞很高（10小时前得知），转入新生儿病房。入院时体温36.8 ℃，脉搏128次/分，呼吸36次/分，反应好。
triageNote.en: Boy aged 18 hours, born by caesarean section at 38 weeks, 3.08 kg. The test done to store his cord blood showed a very high white count (known for 10 hours), so he has been admitted to the neonatal unit. On arrival: temperature 36.8 °C, pulse 128/min, respiratory rate 36/min; alert.

personality.zh-CN: 足月男婴，生后18小时转入新生儿病房，不会说话；入院时精神好、哭声响亮。
personality.en: A term baby boy, admitted to the neonatal unit at 18 hours old, who cannot speak; on admission he is alert with a loud cry.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 不会说话；所有问题由陪同的家属用日常口语回答，不用医学术语，记不清的数字就直说记不清。
speechStyle.en: Does not speak; his relative answers every question in everyday words, without medical terms, and says so when a number has slipped their mind.

openingLine.zh-CN: （他是个刚出生18小时的婴儿，躺在小床里哭声响亮；家属守在旁边。）
openingLine.en: (He is a baby just 18 hours old, lying in his cot with a loud cry; his relative is beside him.)

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：婴儿不说话。入院时（生后18小时）反应好、哭声响、面色欠红润；病情变化阶段身上有出血点，腰骶部有紫红色结节，低热，反应变差。家属回答所有问题：心疼、着急，但只讲自己知道或听孩子妈妈、医生说过的事；检查结果和诊断让医生说；后一阶段的变化只在病例进入那个阶段后才表现，之前不要提；不知道的事就直说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the baby does not speak. On admission (18 hours old) he is alert with a loud cry and a pale colour; in the later phase he has petechiae, a purple-red nodule over the lumbosacral area, a low-grade fever and is less responsive. The relative answers every question — protective and anxious, saying only what they know or have heard from the baby's mother or the doctors; results and the diagnosis are for the doctors; the later change shows only once the case reaches that phase and is never mentioned before; whatever they do not know they say so plainly and never invent.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属，陪着孩子转到新生儿病房；具体是哪位亲属不清楚，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，但愿意配合；用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听孩子妈妈、医生说过的事；数字记不住就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative who came with the baby when he was moved to the neonatal unit; which relative is not known, so add nothing. Worried and protective but cooperative; answers in everyday words, saying only what they know or have heard from the baby's mother or the doctors; admits forgetting numbers and draws no medical conclusions.

nonVerbalReason.en: a newborn, too young to speak

description.zh-CN: 出生时为储存脐血所做的化验发现白细胞很高，他在生后18小时转入新生儿病房。向陪同的家属了解情况、给他查体，开出最初的检查。
description.en: The test done at birth to store his cord blood showed a very high white count, and at 18 hours old he has been admitted to the neonatal unit. Take the history from his relative, examine him and send the first tests.

label.en: From hospital day 2: the diagnostic tests

description.zh-CN: 次日复查了血常规，并做了骨髓形态、免疫分型和遗传学检查（各项检查的具体日期不详）。根据结果明确诊断，然后与家属谈下一步。
description.en: The count was repeated the next day, and marrow morphology, immunophenotyping and genetic tests were done (the exact day of each is not known). Establish the diagnosis from the results, then talk with the family about what comes next.

label.en: From day 4: a change in his condition

description.zh-CN: 住院后他身上出现了出血点；第4天腰骶部长出一个紫红色结节，之后出现低热，反应也变差了。
description.en: Since admission he has developed petechiae; on day 4 a purple-red nodule appeared over the lumbosacral area, and since then he has had a low-grade fever and become less responsive.

text.zh-CN: 报告的诊断为先天性B淋巴细胞白血病。住院后出现出血点；第4天腰骶部出现紫红色结节，未获活检；之后出现低热、反应变差。第9天家属放弃治疗，办理出院。随访得知患儿于生后45天死亡。本病例没有记录住院期间给予了哪些治疗、出院后的照护、死亡原因，也没有记录家属作出这一决定的理由。
text.en: The report's diagnosis is congenital B-lymphoblastic leukaemia. Petechiae appeared after admission; on day 4 a violaceous lumbosacral nodule appeared and was not biopsied; low-grade fever and reduced responsiveness followed. On day 9 the family withdrew treatment and he was discharged. At follow-up he was reported to have died at 45 days of life. This case does not record what treatment he received during the admission, his care after discharge, the cause of death or the family's reasons for their decision.

response.en: Potassium-free IV hydration is running. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服，按体重给药（儿童常用约10 mg/kg/天，分次）；新生儿剂量由专科团队确定。
dose.en: By mouth, weight-based (children commonly about 10 mg/kg/day in divided doses); the newborn dose is set by the specialist team.

response.zh-CN: 已开始别嘌醇。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Allopurinol started. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.2 mg/kg静脉滴注，每日1次（BSH 2015）；用药前必须排除G6PD缺乏。
dose.en: 0.2 mg/kg by IV infusion once daily (BSH 2015); G6PD deficiency must be excluded first.

harm.zh-CN: 拉布立酶在G6PD缺乏症中禁用，可引起急性溶血和高铁血红蛋白血症；BSH 2015要求用药前排除G6PD缺乏，而G6PD缺乏在我国部分地区并不少见。本病例没有他的G6PD结果，这时应先用别嘌醇。
harm.en: Rasburicase is contraindicated in G6PD deficiency, where it causes acute haemolysis and methaemoglobinaemia; BSH 2015 asks for G6PD deficiency to be excluded first, and the deficiency is common in parts of China. No G6PD result is recorded for him, so allopurinol comes first.

response.zh-CN: 已给拉布立酶。本病例没有记录用过拉布立酶；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Rasburicase given. This case does not record its use; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 严格记录出入量，每4–6小时复查电解质、尿酸和肌酐
name.en: Strict fluid balance, with electrolytes, urate and creatinine every 4–6 hours

dose.zh-CN: 每小时记录入量和尿量；每4–6小时复查血钾、磷、钙、尿酸和肌酐，按BSH 2015的风险分层和本地方案调整频率。
dose.en: Hourly intake and urine output; potassium, phosphate, calcium, urate and creatinine every 4–6 hours, the frequency adjusted to the BSH 2015 risk group and the local protocol.

response.zh-CN: 已安排严格记录出入量和定时复查。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Fluid balance and timed bloods are set up. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 持续心肺监护和神经系统观察
name.en: Continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring and neurological observations

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪持续监测心率、呼吸和血氧，定时观察反应和神经系统表现（警惕白细胞淤滞和出血）。
dose.en: Bedside monitor for heart rate, breathing and oxygen saturation, with regular checks of responsiveness and neurological signs (watching for leukostasis and bleeding).

response.zh-CN: 监护仪已连接。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The monitor is attached. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 当天联系儿童血液肿瘤专科

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系儿童血液肿瘤专科，当天评估并商定确诊检查与转诊。
dose.en: Phone paediatric haematology-oncology for a same-day assessment and agree the diagnostic tests and transfer.

response.zh-CN: 儿童血液肿瘤科医生已知情，会来看他并商定检查和转诊。本病例没有记录会诊或转诊的经过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The paediatric haematology-oncology team has been told and will see him and agree the tests and transfer. This case does not record a consultation or transfer; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排家庭会谈（上级医师、专科医生和护士参加）
name.en: Arrange a family meeting with the senior doctor, the specialist and the nurse

dose.zh-CN: 安静的房间，陪同的家属在场，并请父母双方尽量都来；预留足够时间，会后记录谈话内容。
dose.en: A quiet room, with the relative who is here and both parents invited, enough time, and a written record afterwards.

response.zh-CN: 家庭会谈已安排。本病例没有记录与家属沟通的内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The family meeting is arranged. This case does not record what was said to the family; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 请儿科姑息治疗团队参与（并行计划）
name.en: Involve the paediatric palliative care team (parallel planning)

dose.zh-CN: 与家属一起制定并行计划：一边准备专科治疗，一边准备症状控制和舒适照护。
dose.en: Plan in parallel with the family: prepare for specialist treatment and for symptom control and comfort care at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 已请姑息治疗团队参与。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The palliative care team is involved. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 先留血培养，在决定治疗后1小时内静脉给药；方案按NICE NG195（2021，2024年更新）和本地耐药情况，剂量按体重和日龄，怀疑脑膜炎时用脑膜炎剂量。
dose.en: After a blood culture, IV within 1 hour of deciding to treat; regimen per NICE NG195 (2021, updated 2024) and local resistance, doses by weight and postnatal age, at meningitic doses while meningitis is possible.

response.zh-CN: 经验性静脉抗生素已开始。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Empirical IV antibiotics have started. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 按实测血小板计数和出血情况，依BSH 2016阈值输注，剂量按体重计算。
dose.en: For a measured count and bleeding, using the BSH 2016 thresholds, dosed by weight.

response.zh-CN: 已输注血小板。入院后没有再记录血小板计数，无法核对阈值；本病例没有记录是否输过血小板，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Platelets given. No platelet count is recorded after admission, so the threshold cannot be checked; this case does not record a platelet transfusion and does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Exchange transfusion to lower the white count

dose.zh-CN: 由新生儿科和血液肿瘤科决定：用于有白细胞淤滞表现时，不作为外观良好患儿的常规预防；10 kg以下婴儿一般用手工全血换血。
dose.en: Decided by the neonatal and haematology-oncology teams: for signs of leukostasis, not as routine prophylaxis in a baby who looks well; infants under 10 kg usually have a manual whole-blood exchange.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录换血或白细胞单采；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record an exchange transfusion or leukapheresis; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 因面色欠红润输注红细胞（10–20 mL/kg）
name.en: Red-cell top-up for his pallor (10–20 mL/kg)

harm.zh-CN: 白细胞超过500×10⁹/L时，输红细胞会进一步提高血液黏滞度，可诱发白细胞淤滞（脑、肺）。红细胞输注要依据实测血红蛋白和临床表现（BSH 2016新生儿输血指南），并在血液肿瘤科指导下小量、缓慢输注；他的血红蛋白没有记录，面色欠红润本身不是输血指征。
harm.en: With white cells above 500 × 10⁹/L, red cells raise blood viscosity further and can precipitate leukostasis in the brain and lungs. Red-cell transfusion rests on a measured haemoglobin and the clinical picture (BSH 2016 transfusion guideline for neonates), given slowly in small volumes as the haematology-oncology team directs; his haemoglobin is not recorded, and pallor alone is no indication.

response.zh-CN: 已输注红细胞。本病例没有记录输过红细胞；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Red cells given. This case does not record a red-cell transfusion; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 立即用泼尼松龙降低白细胞
name.en: Prednisolone now to bring the white count down

harm.zh-CN: 确诊样本（骨髓形态、免疫分型和遗传学）取得之前用激素，会让原始细胞迅速溶解、诱发肿瘤溶解综合征（BSH 2015），还可能让诊断和分型无法完成。激素预治疗属于确诊后的治疗方案，应在确诊并取得家属同意后由治疗中心开始。
harm.en: Steroids before the diagnostic samples (marrow morphology, immunophenotype and genetics) lyse the blasts quickly and can precipitate tumour lysis syndrome (BSH 2015), and they can leave the diagnosis and classification incomplete. A steroid prephase belongs to the treatment protocol, started by the treating centre after the diagnosis and with the parents' consent.

response.zh-CN: 已给泼尼松龙。本病例没有记录用过激素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Prednisolone given. This case does not record any steroid; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 限制入量并用呋塞米利尿
name.en: Restrict fluids and give furosemide to keep the urine flowing

dose.zh-CN: 限制静脉入量，呋塞米静脉推注。
dose.en: Fluids restricted; furosemide by IV injection.

harm.zh-CN: 预防肿瘤溶解靠充分水化；BSH 2015只在已充分水化、没有低血容量和尿路梗阻时用利尿剂维持尿量，从不用它代替补液。限制入量再利尿会加重容量不足、尿酸和磷在肾内沉积。
harm.en: Tumour-lysis prevention rests on generous hydration; BSH 2015 keeps diuretics for maintaining urine output once the patient is well hydrated, without hypovolaemia or obstruction, never in place of fluid. Restricting fluids and then forcing a diuresis deepens volume depletion and lets urate and phosphate settle in the kidneys.

response.zh-CN: 已执行。本病例没有记录这样处理；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Done. This case does not record it; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 按常规新生儿护理出院，门诊复查血常规
name.en: Routine newborn care: discharge home and recheck the count in clinic

dose.zh-CN: 出院回家，1–2周后门诊复查血常规。
dose.en: Home, with a repeat count in clinic in 1–2 weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 白细胞超过500×10⁹/L伴肝脾肿大是血液急症：计数这么高，肿瘤溶解的风险很高（BSH 2015），还有白细胞淤滞和出血的风险。他需要住院监护和当天的专科评估；外观好、哭声响不能排除危险。
harm.en: White cells above 500 × 10⁹/L with an enlarged liver and spleen are a haematological emergency: at a count this high the risk of tumour lysis is high (BSH 2015), with leukostasis and bleeding on top. He needs monitored inpatient care and a same-day specialist assessment; looking well and crying loudly do not make him safe.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有这样处理（他已收住新生儿病房）；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case did not do this (he was admitted to the neonatal unit); it does not simulate the consequences.

title.en: Find out why he was sent here

hint.zh-CN: 他不会说话，由家属回答：脐血为什么会引起注意？出生和孕期有什么可能相关的情况？家里人的健康和家族史呢？
hint.en: He cannot speak, so his relative answers: what made the cord-blood result a worry, what happened around the birth and in the pregnancy, and what about the family's health and history?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向陪同的家属了解情况。
guidance.en: Go to the cot side and take the history from his relative.

title.en: Examine him from head to toe

hint.zh-CN: 一个看起来很好的新生儿，哪些体征能告诉你血液里出了什么问题？生命体征、面色、皮肤、淋巴结和腹部都看了吗？
hint.en: In a baby who looks well, which signs could show you what is happening in his blood? Have you checked his vital signs, colour, skin, lymph nodes and abdomen?

guidance.en: Examine him at the cot side.

title.zh-CN: 读懂血象，落实最初几小时的处置
title.en: Read the count and act in the first hours

hint.zh-CN: 这个计数和涂片，哪些解释说得通？在确诊之前，接下来几小时里什么可能出事，你怎样预防？
hint.en: Which explanations fit this count and film? Before the diagnosis is confirmed, what could go wrong in the next few hours, and how will you prevent it?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出入院检查，在会诊板作答决策1和决策2，并在床旁落实决策2选定的处置。
guidance.en: Send the admission tests, answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board, and carry out the decision 2 plan at the cot side.

title.en: Pin down the diagnosis and its type

hint.zh-CN: 哪些标记能确定系别？一个阴性的遗传学结果能排除什么、不能排除什么？
hint.en: Which markers decide the lineage? What can a negative genetic result rule out — and what can it not?

guidance.zh-CN: 住院第2天起：查看复查的血常规和确诊检查结果，作答决策3。
guidance.en: From hospital day 2: read the repeat count and the diagnostic results, then answer decision 3.

title.en: Talk with the family about the next steps

hint.zh-CN: 家属已经知道什么、想知道多少？你怎样把可能的选择和其中的不确定性讲清楚？
hint.en: What does the family already know, and how much do they want to know? How will you set out the choices and the uncertainty in them?

guidance.zh-CN: 安排家庭会谈，作答决策4。
guidance.en: Arrange the family meeting and answer decision 4.

title.zh-CN: 应对病情变化，回顾结局
title.en: Respond to the change and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 新生儿发热、反应变差，最先要排除什么？哪些检查不用搬动他就能做？
hint.en: In a newborn with a fever who is less responsive, what must you rule out first — and which tests need no move?

guidance.zh-CN: 第4天起他的情况有变化：重新查看他，作答决策5，最后调阅转归记录。
guidance.en: From day 4 his condition changes: re-examine him, answer decision 5, then read the outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 生后18小时的足月男婴，反应好但面色欠红润，肝脾肿大；入院血常规白细胞513.62×10⁹/L，血小板94×10⁹/L，涂片原幼淋巴细胞占95%。最可能是什么？怎样确认？
prompt.en: An 18-hour-old term boy is alert but pale, with an enlarged liver and spleen. Admission white cells are 513.62 × 10⁹/L and platelets 94 × 10⁹/L, with 95 % lymphoblasts and prolymphocytes on the film. What is most likely, and how will you confirm it?

need.zh-CN: 先问清他为什么被转来，看他的一般情况、摸肝脾，并调阅入院血常规和涂片。
need.en: First find out why he was sent, look at him and feel his liver and spleen, and read the admission count and film.

text.zh-CN: 新生儿（先天性）白血病：原幼淋巴细胞占绝对优势，伴肝脾肿大和血小板减少，按血液急症处理；用流式免疫分型和骨髓检查定系别，并查有无唐氏综合征特征
text.en: Neonatal (congenital) leukaemia: immature lymphoid cells dominate, with an enlarged liver and spleen and low platelets — treat it as a haematological emergency, set the lineage by flow cytometry and marrow, and look for Down's syndrome features

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。白细胞超过500×10⁹/L、以原幼淋巴细胞为主，伴肝脾肿大和血小板减少，反应性改变解释不了（Roberts等《新生儿白血病》综述，Br J Haematol 2018）。WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022）要求用免疫分型定系别、用遗传学分型；暂时性异常骨髓造血只见于唐氏综合征，原始细胞属髓系，所以要看有无唐氏特征。
feedback.en: Right. A white count above 500 × 10⁹/L made up mostly of immature lymphoid cells, with an enlarged liver and spleen and low platelets, is not reactive (Roberts et al., review of neonatal leukaemia, Br J Haematol 2018). The WHO classification, 5th edition (2022), sets the lineage by immunophenotyping and the subtype by genetics; transient abnormal myelopoiesis occurs only with Down's syndrome and its blasts are myeloid, hence the look for Down's features.

text.zh-CN: 围产期应激或感染引起的类白血病反应：新生儿白细胞本来偏高，他又反应好，先做感染筛查、需要时用抗生素，24–48小时后复查血常规，再决定是否请血液科
text.en: A leukaemoid reaction to perinatal stress or infection: newborn white counts run high in the first days and he is alert, so screen for infection, treat it if needed and repeat the count in 24–48 hours before deciding whether the haematology team should see him

feedback.zh-CN: 类白血病反应很少达到这样的计数，而且以成熟中的粒细胞为主，不会以原幼淋巴细胞为主；他还有肝脾肿大和血小板减少。等24–48小时会错过预防肿瘤溶解的时机——BSH 2015指南把白细胞≥100×10⁹/L的急性淋巴细胞白血病列为高危。
feedback.en: A leukaemoid reaction rarely reaches this count and is made of maturing neutrophils, not immature lymphoid cells; he also has an enlarged liver and spleen and low platelets. Waiting 24–48 hours loses the window for tumour-lysis prevention — the BSH 2015 guideline puts ALL with white cells ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L at high risk.

text.zh-CN: 唐氏综合征相关的暂时性异常骨髓造血：这是新生儿外周血原始细胞大量增多最常见的原因，多数可自行消退，所以先送染色体核型，结果出来之前观察即可
text.en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down's syndrome: the commonest cause of many circulating blasts in a newborn, and it usually settles by itself, so send a karyotype and observe him until the result is back

feedback.zh-CN: 暂时性异常骨髓造血确实是新生儿外周血原始细胞增多的常见原因，但它只见于唐氏综合征（含嵌合型），原始细胞属髓系（巨核系）；这里涂片报告的是原幼淋巴细胞，系别必须用免疫分型确认（Roberts等，2018）。核型结果出来之前，这样高的白细胞也不能只观察。
feedback.en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis is a common cause of circulating blasts in a newborn, but it occurs only with Down's syndrome (including mosaicism) and its blasts are myeloid (megakaryoblastic); this film reports immature lymphoid cells, and the lineage needs immunophenotyping (Roberts et al., 2018). A count this high cannot simply be watched while the karyotype is pending.

text.zh-CN: 仪器计数误差：新生儿血里有核红细胞多，血液分析仪会把它们当成白细胞；做手工分类核实后，白细胞会大幅下降，不需要其他处理
text.en: An analyser artefact: newborn blood carries many nucleated red cells that the counter reads as white cells, so a manual differential will bring the count right down and nothing else is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 分析仪确实可能把有核红细胞计入白细胞，所以要看涂片——但这张涂片已经报告原幼淋巴细胞占95%，有核红细胞解释不了，也解释不了肝脾肿大和血小板减少。按WHO第5版（2022），原始细胞的系别要靠免疫分型确定。
feedback.en: Analysers can count nucleated red cells as white cells, which is why the film matters — but this film already reports 95 % immature lymphoid cells, which nucleated red cells cannot explain, any more than the enlarged liver and spleen or the low platelets. Under the WHO 5th edition (2022), the blasts' lineage is set by immunophenotyping.

prompt.zh-CN: 他白细胞513.62×10⁹/L，肝脾肿大，血小板94×10⁹/L，目前反应好。在确诊结果出来之前，最初几小时怎么处理？
prompt.en: His white count is 513.62 × 10⁹/L, his liver and spleen are enlarged and his platelets are 94 × 10⁹/L; he is alert. Before the diagnostic results are back, what is your plan for the first hours?

text.zh-CN: 按肿瘤溶解高危处理：不含钾的静脉水化，G6PD结果出来前先用别嘌醇，每4–6小时查电解质、尿酸和肌酐并记出入量；没有实测指征不输红细胞；持续监护；当天联系儿童血液肿瘤专科
text.en: Treat him as high risk for tumour lysis: potassium-free IV fluids, allopurinol until a G6PD result is known, electrolytes, urate and creatinine every 4–6 hours with a fluid balance; no red cells without a measured need; continuous monitoring; same-day haematology-oncology

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BSH 2015肿瘤溶解综合征指南：白细胞≥100×10⁹/L的急性淋巴细胞白血病属高危，需要不含钾的充分水化、控制尿酸（拉布立酶只在排除G6PD缺乏后使用）和频繁复查电解质与尿量。白细胞这么高时，红细胞会加重血液黏滞度，只在实测需要时输注（BSH 2016新生儿输血指南）；还应尽早请有婴儿白血病经验的团队评估。
feedback.en: Right. The BSH 2015 tumour-lysis guideline puts ALL with white cells ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L at high risk: potassium-free hydration, uric-acid control (rasburicase only once G6PD deficiency is excluded) and frequent electrolytes and urine output. At this count red cells add to blood viscosity, so they are given only for a measured need (BSH 2016 transfusion guideline for neonates); a team experienced in infant leukaemia should see him early.

text.zh-CN: 他面色欠红润、白细胞又高得危险：先输红细胞10–20 mL/kg纠正贫血、改善氧供，再马上换血，把白细胞降到100×10⁹/L以下以防白细胞淤滞；同时开始静脉水化、持续监护，并请儿童血液肿瘤专科会诊
text.en: He is pale and his count is dangerously high, so give red cells 10–20 mL/kg to correct the anaemia and his oxygen delivery, then an immediate exchange transfusion to bring the white count below 100 × 10⁹/L and prevent leukostasis; start IV fluids and continuous monitoring, and ask haematology-oncology to see him

feedback.zh-CN: 他的血红蛋白没有记录，面色欠红润本身不是输血指征（BSH 2016新生儿输血指南）；白细胞超过500×10⁹/L时输红细胞会进一步提高黏滞度、诱发白细胞淤滞。换血或白细胞单采不作为外观良好患儿的常规预防，要由专科团队根据淤滞表现决定。
feedback.en: His haemoglobin is not recorded, and pallor alone is no indication for transfusion (BSH 2016 transfusion guideline for neonates); above 500 × 10⁹/L, red cells raise viscosity further and can precipitate leukostasis. Exchange transfusion or leukapheresis is not routine prophylaxis in a baby who looks well; the specialist team decides on it for signs of leukostasis.

text.zh-CN: 现在就口服泼尼松龙，让白细胞尽快降下来，同时开始静脉水化、别嘌醇和持续监护；骨髓穿刺和免疫分型等白细胞降低、病情稳定后再做，以免出血
text.en: Start oral prednisolone now to bring the white count down quickly, with IV fluids, allopurinol and continuous monitoring; leave the marrow and immunophenotyping until the count has fallen and he is more stable, to avoid bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 确诊样本取得之前用激素，会让白血病细胞迅速溶解、诱发肿瘤溶解综合征（BSH 2015），还可能让免疫分型和遗传学检查无法完成。外周血原始细胞这么多，免疫分型可以马上做；激素预治疗是婴儿白血病方案的一部分，应在确诊后由专科开始。
feedback.en: Steroids before the diagnostic samples lyse the blasts quickly and can precipitate tumour lysis syndrome (BSH 2015), and they can leave the immunophenotype and genetics incomplete. With this many circulating blasts, immunophenotyping can be done at once; the steroid prephase belongs to the infant-leukaemia protocol, started by the specialist team after diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 他反应好、生命体征平稳：按常规新生儿护理，限制入量以保护新生儿肾脏，明早复查血常规和涂片，再决定是否需要特殊处理或转诊
text.en: He is alert with stable vital signs: routine newborn care with fluids restricted to protect his kidneys, a repeat count and film in the morning, and then a decision on whether anything special or a referral is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 外观好不能排除危险：BSH 2015把白细胞≥100×10⁹/L的急性淋巴细胞白血病列为肿瘤溶解高危，还有白细胞淤滞和出血的风险。限制入量与预防所需的充分水化正好相反，等到明早会错过预防的时机。
feedback.en: Looking well does not make him safe: BSH 2015 puts ALL with white cells ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L at high risk of tumour lysis, and leukostasis and bleeding are added risks. Restricting fluids is the opposite of the hydration prevention needs, and waiting until the morning misses the window.

prompt.zh-CN: 骨髓原幼淋巴细胞91%，POX染色阴性；流式异常细胞群占89%，表达CD19、cCD79a、CD34和HLA-DR；染色体核型未见异常，多重RT-PCR未检出融合基因。这些结果说明了什么？还缺什么？
prompt.en: Marrow: 91 % lymphoblasts and prolymphocytes, POX negative. Flow cytometry: an abnormal population of 89 % expressing CD19, cCD79a, CD34 and HLA-DR. Karyotype: no abnormality; multiplex RT-PCR: no fusion gene detected. What do these establish, and what is still missing?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅骨髓形态、免疫分型、核型和融合基因筛查结果。
need.en: First read the marrow morphology, the immunophenotype, the karyotype and the fusion screen.

text.zh-CN: B淋巴母细胞白血病可以确立（CD19、cCD79a阳性，POX阴性）；但正常核型和这套RT-PCR都排除不了婴儿最常见的KMT2A重排，需做KMT2A分离探针FISH并补齐CD10等标记，再定危险度
text.en: B-lymphoblastic leukaemia is established (CD19 and cCD79a positive, POX negative), but neither the normal karyotype nor this RT-PCR excludes a KMT2A rearrangement, the commonest lesion in infant ALL: send KMT2A break-apart FISH and complete CD10 and the other markers before assigning risk

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CD19加cCD79a确定B系，POX阴性符合淋巴系（WHO第5版，2022）。KMT2A重排是婴儿急性淋巴细胞白血病最重要的预后因素（Interfant-06，Pieters等，J Clin Oncol 2019）；它的伙伴基因很多，可在核型上隐匿，有限的RT-PCR也可能漏检，所以要用分离探针FISH（必要时用RNA方法）。CD10阴性的pro-B表型常与KMT2A重排相伴，这里CD10没有记录。
feedback.en: Right. CD19 with cCD79a sets B lineage, and POX negativity fits a lymphoid leukaemia (WHO 5th edition, 2022). KMT2A rearrangement is the strongest prognostic factor in infant ALL (Interfant-06, Pieters et al., J Clin Oncol 2019); it has many partner genes, can be cryptic on the karyotype and can escape a limited RT-PCR panel, so break-apart FISH (or an RNA-based test) is needed. A CD10-negative pro-B phenotype often goes with it, and CD10 is not recorded here.

text.zh-CN: POX阴性，加上CD34和HLA-DR阳性，提示微分化型急性髓系白血病（M0）；婴儿白血病常有跨系表达，CD19和cCD79a可能只是异常表达的B系抗原，因此应按急性髓系白血病方案治疗，并请髓系白血病专家会诊
text.en: POX negativity with CD34 and HLA-DR suggests minimally differentiated acute myeloid leukaemia (M0); cross-lineage antigens are common in infant leukaemia, so CD19 and cCD79a may be aberrant B antigens, and he should be treated on an acute myeloid leukaemia protocol with a myeloid-leukaemia specialist's opinion

feedback.zh-CN: POX阴性不能证明是髓系：定为髓系需要MPO等髓系标记阳性，CD34和HLA-DR只是前体细胞标记，不决定系别。POX（细胞化学髓过氧化物酶）阴性、也没有报告任何髓系标记阳性时，CD19加cCD79a即可定为B系，不能当作异常表达（WHO第5版，2022）。
feedback.en: A negative POX does not make it myeloid: myeloid lineage needs positive myeloid markers such as MPO, and CD34 and HLA-DR are precursor markers that set no lineage. With the POX (cytochemical myeloperoxidase) negative and no myeloid marker reported, CD19 with cCD79a assigns B lineage and cannot be dismissed as aberrant (WHO 5th edition, 2022).

text.zh-CN: B淋巴母细胞白血病，核型正常、融合基因阴性，说明没有不良遗传学改变，属于标危；可以在本院按大龄儿童的标危方案开始诱导，减少转院带来的风险和费用
text.en: B-lymphoblastic leukaemia with a normal karyotype and no fusion gene, so no adverse genetics and standard risk: start induction here on the standard-risk protocol used for older children, sparing him the risks and costs of a transfer

feedback.zh-CN: 婴儿（1岁以下）急性淋巴细胞白血病本身就是高危：Interfant-06（Pieters等，2019）显示KMT2A重排、年龄、白细胞计数和泼尼松反应决定预后，而他的KMT2A状态还不清楚。应转到有婴儿白血病经验的中心按婴儿方案治疗，而不是用大龄儿童的标危方案。
feedback.en: ALL in infancy is high risk in itself: Interfant-06 (Pieters et al., 2019) found that KMT2A rearrangement, age, white count and prednisone response decide the outlook, and his KMT2A status is still unknown. He needs an infant protocol at an experienced centre, not the standard-risk protocol for older children.

text.zh-CN: CD34和HLA-DR是干细胞和髓系相关标记，与CD19、cCD79a同时表达，符合混合表型急性白血病，需要按混合表型白血病方案治疗，并补做髓系抗原检测
text.en: CD34 and HLA-DR are stem-cell and myeloid-associated markers expressed alongside CD19 and cCD79a, which fits mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia and calls for a mixed-phenotype protocol, with myeloid antigens added to the panel

feedback.zh-CN: 混合表型急性白血病要求两个系别各自的特异性标记（例如髓系的MPO或T系的胞质CD3）；CD34和HLA-DR是前体细胞标记，不定系别（WHO第5版，2022）。这里报告的定系标记只有B系，POX阴性；髓系和T系标记没有记录，这是补齐检测的理由，不是第二个系别的证据。
feedback.en: Mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia needs lineage-specific markers of two lineages (such as myeloid MPO or T-cell cytoplasmic CD3); CD34 and HLA-DR are precursor markers that define none (WHO 5th edition, 2022). Only B-lineage markers are reported here and the POX is negative; the myeloid and T-cell panel is not recorded, which is a reason to complete it, not evidence of a second lineage.

prompt.zh-CN: 检查结果确认是B淋巴母细胞白血病，KMT2A状态还不清楚。和家属谈话、制定下一步计划，哪种做法最恰当？
prompt.en: The results confirm B-lymphoblastic leukaemia, and his KMT2A status is not yet known. Which approach to the family conversation and the plan is best?

need.zh-CN: 先完成对确诊检查结果的判读。

text.zh-CN: 在安静的房间按SPIKES与家属谈：问他们知道多少、想知道多少；如实讲清诊断及婴儿方案的机会与负担；姑息治疗作为同等选择并行计划；照护不断，约好再谈
text.en: Meet the family in a quiet room (SPIKES): ask what they know and want to know; be honest about the diagnosis and an infant protocol's chances and burdens; plan palliative care in parallel as an equal choice; keep caring for him; agree when to talk again

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按SPIKES（Baile等，Oncologist 2000）分步告知坏消息；BAPM 2025围产期姑息治疗框架主张在结局不确定时与家属共同决策、并行计划，姑息治疗不等于放弃照护。治疗的机会真实但不大：生后1个月内诊断的急性淋巴细胞白血病按Interfant-99治疗，2年无事件生存20%，作者仍认为应以治愈为目标治疗（van der Linden等，Blood 2009）；Interfant-06高危组（他若有KMT2A重排即属此组）6年无事件生存20.9%（Pieters等，J Clin Oncol 2019）。积极治疗和姑息治疗都是正当的选择，KMT2A结果会让预后更明确。
feedback.en: Right. SPIKES (Baile et al., Oncologist 2000) structures breaking bad news, and the BAPM 2025 perinatal palliative-care framework asks for shared decisions and parallel planning when the outcome is uncertain — palliative care never means withdrawing care. Treatment offers a real but small chance: ALL diagnosed in the first month of life had a 2-year event-free survival of 20 % on Interfant-99, and its authors still judged curative treatment justified (van der Linden et al., Blood 2009); Interfant-06's high-risk group, where he belongs if KMT2A-rearranged, had a 6-year EFS of 20.9 % (Pieters et al., J Clin Oncol 2019). Treatment and palliative care are both legitimate choices, and the KMT2A result will sharpen the outlook.

text.zh-CN: 直接告诉家属，出生时就发病的白血病没有治疗希望——类似报道里的孩子几周内都死了——劝他们放弃，接孩子回家，不必再做检查，以免孩子多受罪、家里多花钱
text.en: Tell the family that leukaemia present from birth cannot be treated — babies in such reports die within weeks — and advise them to stop, take him home and skip further tests, to spare him suffering and the family the cost

feedback.zh-CN: 这是把单个历史个案当成定论，还替家属作了决定。出生时就发病的白血病难治，但并非无法治疗：按Interfant-99治疗，约五分之一的患儿2年无事件生存，作者认为应以治愈为目标治疗（van der Linden等，Blood 2009）。家属需要这些真实的数字和尚未出来的KMT2A结果才能作出选择；姑息治疗是正当的选择，但应在了解全部选项后与家属共同决定（BAPM 2025）。
feedback.en: This turns a single historical case into a verdict and decides for the family. Leukaemia present from birth is hard to cure but not untreatable: about one in five such infants were event-free at 2 years on Interfant-99, and its authors judged treatment with curative intent justified (van der Linden et al., Blood 2009). The family needs these real figures, and the pending KMT2A result, to choose; palliative care is a legitimate choice, made with them once every option is known (BAPM 2025).

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属先天性白血病常常会自己缓解，所以先不化疗，每周复查一次血常规，观察几个月再决定，这样也能让新生儿避开化疗的毒性
text.en: Tell the family that congenital leukaemia often remits on its own, so hold off chemotherapy, check his count every week and decide in a few months, sparing a newborn the toxicity of chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 自发缓解主要见于唐氏综合征的暂时性异常骨髓造血和少数新生儿白血病（尤其是伴t(8;16)的髓系白血病），在伴极高白细胞的B淋巴母细胞白血病中不能指望（Roberts等，Br J Haematol 2018）。观察等待会让他承受肿瘤溶解、出血和感染的风险而得不到治疗。
feedback.en: Spontaneous remission is seen mainly in the transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down's syndrome and in a few neonatal leukaemias, especially myeloid ones with t(8;16); it cannot be counted on in B-lymphoblastic leukaemia with this count (Roberts et al., Br J Haematol 2018). Waiting exposes him to tumour lysis, bleeding and infection without treatment.

text.zh-CN: 今天就建议转到专科中心按婴儿方案治疗，向家属详细讲清这个方案的获益、风险、疗程和费用；只有在他们明确拒绝治疗之后才提起姑息治疗，以免过早打击家属的希望
text.en: Recommend transfer today to a specialist centre for treatment on an infant protocol and go through its benefits, risks, length and costs in detail with the family; bring up palliative care only if they decline treatment, so as not to take away their hope too early

feedback.zh-CN: 坦诚、出于好意，但把姑息治疗当成了退路，而不是与治疗并列的选择：BAPM 2025框架要求结局不确定时从一开始就讨论姑息治疗、并行计划，并与家属共同决定。出生即发病的白血病只有约五分之一的患儿2年无事件生存（van der Linden等，2009），等家属拒绝治疗才提这个选项，等于剥夺了他们知情选择的机会。
feedback.en: Honest and well meant, but it makes palliative care a fallback instead of a choice offered alongside treatment: the BAPM 2025 framework asks for palliative care to be discussed and planned in parallel from the start when the outcome is uncertain, with the decision made together with the family. With only about one in five infants event-free at 2 years after leukaemia from birth (van der Linden et al., 2009), holding the option back until they refuse treatment denies them an informed choice.

prompt.zh-CN: 住院后他身上出现出血点；第4天腰骶部长出一个紫红色结节；之后出现低热，反应变差。现在首先怎么做？
prompt.en: Since admission he has developed petechiae; on day 4 a violaceous nodule appeared over the lumbosacral area; since then he has had a low-grade fever and become less responsive. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先重新查看他：皮肤、体温和反应。
need.en: Re-examine him first: skin, temperature and responsiveness.

text.zh-CN: 按疑似晚发型败血症处理：先抽血培养，决定治疗后1小时内开始静脉抗生素；查血常规和凝血，按实测结果输血小板；床旁头颅超声查颅内出血；腰穿等安全时再做，暂按脑膜炎剂量用药
text.en: Treat it as suspected late-onset sepsis: blood culture, then IV antibiotics within 1 hour of deciding to treat; a blood count and clotting, with platelets for a measured low count; a bedside cranial ultrasound for bleeding; defer the lumbar puncture until it is safe, dosing for meningitis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。NICE NG195（2021，2024年更新）：新生儿疑似感染应在决定治疗后1小时内开始静脉抗生素，先留血培养，腰穿只在安全且不耽误用药时进行。白血病伴出血点的新生儿反应变差，还要想到颅内出血和白细胞淤滞，床旁头颅超声不用搬动他；外周血原始细胞多、血小板低时，损伤性腰穿还可能把原始细胞带进脑脊液。
feedback.en: Right. NICE NG195 (2021, updated 2024): give IV antibiotics within 1 hour of the decision to treat a suspected neonatal infection, after a blood culture, and do a lumbar puncture only when it is safe and does not delay them. A newborn with leukaemia and petechiae who becomes less responsive may also be bleeding into the brain or have leukostasis, and a bedside cranial ultrasound needs no move; with circulating blasts and low platelets, a traumatic tap can also carry blasts into the spinal fluid.

text.zh-CN: 低热和出血点都是白血病本身的表现（肿瘤热），腰骶部结节就是白血病皮肤浸润：用对乙酰氨基酚退热，继续观察和支持治疗，等家属对是否化疗作出决定，暂不加用抗生素以免掩盖病情
text.en: The fever and the spots are the leukaemia itself (tumour fever) and the lumbosacral nodule is leukaemic skin infiltration: give paracetamol for the temperature, keep up observation and supportive care, and wait for the family's decision on chemotherapy, holding antibiotics so as not to mask the picture

feedback.zh-CN: 白血病可以引起发热，但新生儿发热必须先按感染处理——延误抗生素可能致命（NICE NG195，2021，2024年更新）。反应变差还要排查颅内出血；等待家属决定期间，支持治疗和抗感染仍要继续。
feedback.en: Leukaemia can cause fever, but in a newborn fever is treated as infection first — delayed antibiotics can be fatal (NICE NG195, 2021, updated 2024). Reduced responsiveness also needs a look for intracranial bleeding, and supportive care and antibiotics continue while the family decides.

text.zh-CN: 先给结节做活检，明确是不是白血病皮肤浸润，因为这会改变分期和治疗；结果出来之前暂不用抗生素，免得影响血培养和之后的判断
text.en: Biopsy the nodule first to prove leukaemic skin infiltration, since that changes staging and treatment; hold antibiotics until the result is back so as not to spoil the blood culture or the later picture

feedback.zh-CN: 皮肤活检可以证实白血病皮肤浸润，但不改变他在婴儿方案中的危险度分组（由KMT2A状态、年龄、白细胞和泼尼松反应决定——Interfant-06），也不是今天最急的事；他有出血点，入院后没有血小板计数的记录，活检本身也有出血风险。抗生素不能因此推迟：NICE NG195（2021，2024年更新）要求在决定治疗后1小时内用药，血培养在用药前采集即可。
feedback.en: A skin biopsy can confirm leukaemic infiltration, but it does not change his infant-protocol risk group (set by KMT2A status, age, white count and prednisone response — Interfant-06) and it is not today's priority; with petechiae and no platelet count recorded since admission, the biopsy carries its own bleeding risk. It must not delay antibiotics: NICE NG195 (2021, updated 2024) asks for them within 1 hour of the decision to treat, with the blood culture taken first.

text.zh-CN: 新生儿发热、反应差，先在床旁做腰穿排除脑膜炎，拿到脑脊液结果后再决定用哪种抗生素、用多久；同时抽血培养，查血常规
text.en: A febrile, less responsive newborn needs a lumbar puncture on the ward first to rule out meningitis; choose the antibiotics and their length once the CSF results are back, with a blood culture and count meanwhile

feedback.zh-CN: NICE NG195（2021，2024年更新）只在安全时做腰穿——先稳定出血风险——且不能因此延误用药；他有出血点、血小板可能很低，外周血满是原始细胞，损伤性腰穿还可能把原始细胞带进脑脊液。先用抗生素（按可能的脑膜炎剂量），腰穿等安全时由专科安排。
feedback.en: NICE NG195 (2021, updated 2024) has the lumbar puncture done only when it is safe — with the bleeding risk stabilised first — and never at the cost of delaying treatment; with petechiae, a platelet count that may be very low and blasts throughout his blood, a traumatic tap could also seed the spinal fluid. Start antibiotics at meningitic doses and leave the tap until the specialist team can do it safely.

text.zh-CN: 问清脐血结果、出生方式与孕周、孕期暴露、父母和哥哥的健康以及家族史
text.en: Elicited the cord-blood result, the mode and timing of birth, pregnancy exposures, the parents' and brother's health and the family history

text.zh-CN: 追问产检和唐氏筛查、母亲孕期感染、出生后用药（维生素K）和疫苗
text.en: Asked about antenatal and Down's screening, infection in pregnancy, medicines since birth (vitamin K) and vaccines

text.zh-CN: 测生命体征，查看反应和面色、全身皮肤、浅表淋巴结，并触诊肝脾
text.en: Took the vital signs, looked at his alertness, colour and skin, felt for lymph nodes and palpated the liver and spleen

text.zh-CN: 入院时看血常规和涂片、送凝血和G6PD；确诊阶段调阅骨髓形态、免疫分型、核型和融合基因结果
text.en: Read the admission count and film and sent clotting and G6PD; in the diagnostic phase read the marrow, immunophenotype, karyotype and fusion screen

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为新生儿白血病，并计划用免疫分型和骨髓确定系别
text.en: Recognised probable neonatal leukaemia and planned immunophenotyping and marrow to set its lineage, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 最初几小时开始预防肿瘤溶解：不含钾的静脉水化、别嘌醇，并在入院时送检电解质、肾功能和尿酸（或安排每4–6小时复查）
text.en: Started tumour-lysis prevention in the first hours: potassium-free IV hydration and allopurinol, with electrolytes, renal function and urate sent on admission or charted 4–6-hourly

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择高白细胞的初始方案，并当天联系儿童血液肿瘤专科、上持续监护
text.en: Chose the plan for the extreme count at the first attempt, called haematology-oncology the same day and set up continuous monitoring

text.zh-CN: 没有做危险的处置：因面色差输红细胞、确诊前用激素、不查G6PD就用拉布立酶、限液加利尿、常规出院，或在病房随手腰穿
text.en: Avoided the dangerous steps: red cells for pallor, steroids before the diagnosis, rasburicase without a G6PD result, fluid restriction with a diuretic, routine discharge, or an unplanned lumbar puncture on the ward

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即确立B系、指出KMT2A状态仍需FISH明确，并送检FISH
text.en: Established the B lineage and the still-open KMT2A question at the first attempt, and sent the FISH

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择与家属共同决策的谈话方式，安排家庭会谈并请姑息治疗团队参与
text.en: Chose a shared, honest conversation with the family at the first attempt, arranged the family meeting and involved palliative care

text.zh-CN: 病情变化时首次作答即按疑似败血症处理：送血培养、开始静脉抗生素，并做床旁头颅超声
text.en: When he deteriorated, treated suspected sepsis at the first attempt: blood culture, IV antibiotics and a bedside cranial ultrasound

text.zh-CN: 按SPIKES向家属说明诊断、选择和不确定性，并共同决策
text.en: Told the family the diagnosis, the choices and the uncertainty with SPIKES, and shared the decision

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES）：选安静的房间，请上级医师和护士在场，陪同的家属在场，并请孩子的父母尽量都来；先问家属已经知道什么、想知道多少——孩子看上去很好，家属可能难以相信；用通俗的话说明“血里有大量不成熟的白细胞，是一种白血病”，解释为什么白细胞这么高本身就危险、现在正在做什么（补液、保护肾脏、监护）；坦诚说明治疗意味着在专科中心接受强化治疗，治愈的机会真实但不大——出生即发病的白血病约五分之一——KMT2A结果出来后预后会更明确；把姑息治疗作为同样正当的选择，说明无论怎么决定都会继续照顾孩子；回应情绪、留出时间提问，用回授法确认理解，约好下次再谈并记录。不要把全体婴儿的生存率当成他的机会，不要用这例报告的死亡结局证明治疗无效，不要施压，也不要替家属作决定。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES): a quiet room with the senior doctor and the nurse, the relative who is here, and his parents invited (both if possible); first asks what the family knows and wants to know — he looks well, so they may struggle to believe it; explains in plain words that “his blood is full of immature white cells — a kind of leukaemia”, why a count this high is dangerous in itself and what is being done now (fluids, protecting his kidneys, monitoring); is honest that treatment means intensive therapy at a specialist centre with a real but small chance of cure — about one in five for leukaemia present from birth — and that the KMT2A result will sharpen the outlook; presents palliative care as an equally legitimate choice and makes clear he will be cared for whatever they decide; responds to emotion, leaves time for questions, checks understanding by teach-back, agrees when to talk again and documents it. Does not quote the all-infant survival figures as his chances, does not use this report's death as proof that treatment fails, does not apply pressure and does not decide for the family.

name.zh-CN: 华医生（新生儿科上级医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“新生儿白细胞这么高可能有哪些原因？靠什么把它们区分开？”“确诊之前，接下来几小时最怕出什么事？白细胞这么高时，哪些看似合理的做法反而会让情况更糟？”“哪些标记能定系别？阴性的遗传学结果能排除什么、不能排除什么？”“你会怎样开始和家属的谈话？你会向他们提供哪些选择？”“新生儿发热、反应变差时先排除什么？”说明这是2011年发表的历史病例：当年的检查范围与现在不同，它的病程不能用来评价现在的治疗。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局，陷阱和答案留到复盘时再讲；血红蛋白、凝血、电解质、G6PD、CD10、KMT2A、脑脊液、住院期间的治疗和是否接种过卡介苗都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Neonatal attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “What can make a newborn's white count this high, and what tells the causes apart?”, “Before the diagnosis is confirmed, what are you most afraid of in the next hours — and at this count, which steps that look reasonable could make things worse?”, “Which markers set the lineage, and what can a negative genetic result rule out — and what not?”, “How will you open the conversation with the family, and what will you offer them?”, “What do you rule out first when a newborn becomes febrile and less responsive?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2011: its testing differs from today's, and its course is no measure of treatment now. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early, and keeps the traps and the answers for the debrief; haemoglobin, clotting, electrolytes, G6PD, CD10, KMT2A, the CSF, the treatment given during the admission and whether BCG was given are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：生后18小时男婴，孕38周剖宫产，体重3.08 kg；为储存脐血所做的化验提示白细胞很高，转入本病房；入院体温36.8 ℃，脉搏128次/分，呼吸36次/分，反应好；家属在床旁。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血、上监护、用输液泵补液、送检标本、联系血库，并按医嘱记录出入量。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（如血红蛋白、尿量、用过的药）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Neonatal unit nurse. Handover (ISBAR): boy aged 18 hours, born by caesarean section at 38 weeks, 3.08 kg; the test done to store his cord blood showed a very high white count, so he was admitted here; on arrival temperature 36.8 °C, pulse 128/min, respiratory rate 36/min, alert; a relative is at the cot side. Can help with IV access and bloods, the monitor, fluids on an infusion pump, sending samples, the blood bank and the fluid-balance chart. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (his haemoglobin, urine output, any medicines given).

name.zh-CN: 钟医生（儿童血液肿瘤科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童血液肿瘤科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：WHO第5版（2022）的定系原则（B系看CD19加cCD79a等；髓系需要MPO；T系需要胞质CD3；CD34、HLA-DR不定系别）；婴儿急性淋巴细胞白血病中KMT2A重排的意义和检测方法（分离探针FISH、RNA方法），CD10阴性的pro-B表型；BSH 2015的肿瘤溶解预防；婴儿白血病要在有经验的中心按婴儿方案治疗（Interfant-06），以及适用于他的机会：Interfant-06全体婴儿6年无事件生存46.1%，高危组只有20.9%；生后1个月内诊断的急性淋巴细胞白血病按Interfant-99治疗，2年无事件生存20%（van der Linden 2009）。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric haematology-oncology consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain the WHO 5th edition (2022) lineage rules (B lineage from CD19 with cCD79a and similar; myeloid needs MPO; T needs cytoplasmic CD3; CD34 and HLA-DR set no lineage); the meaning of KMT2A rearrangement in infant ALL and how it is tested (break-apart FISH, RNA-based methods), and the CD10-negative pro-B phenotype; tumour-lysis prevention per BSH 2015; why infant leukaemia is treated on an infant protocol at an experienced centre (Interfant-06), and the odds that apply to him: 46.1 % 6-year EFS for all infants on Interfant-06 but 20.9 % in its high-risk group, and 20 % 2-year EFS for ALL diagnosed in the first month of life on Interfant-99 (van der Linden 2009). Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：脐血发现的先天性B淋巴母细胞白血病
title.en: Debrief: congenital B-lymphoblastic leukaemia found on a cord-blood count

conclusion.zh-CN: 生后18小时足月男婴（孕38周剖宫产，3.08 kg）因储存脐血时化验白细胞很高入院。他外观良好（体温36.8 ℃，脉搏128次/分，呼吸36次/分），但面色欠红润，肝肋下4 cm、脾肋下1.5 cm，质韧。入院白细胞513.62×10⁹/L，原幼淋巴细胞95%，血小板94×10⁹/L；次日白细胞556.94×10⁹/L。骨髓原幼淋巴细胞91%、POX阴性，流式表达CD19、cCD79a、CD34、HLA-DR，报告诊断先天性B淋巴细胞白血病；核型和有限的多重RT-PCR均阴性。之后出现出血点、未活检的腰骶部结节、低热和反应变差；第9天家属放弃治疗，生后45天死亡。现行做法：把极高白细胞当急症，在确诊前就预防肿瘤溶解（BSH 2015），查KMT2A重排，转到按婴儿方案治疗的中心并如实说明机会（出生即发病者约五分之一），发热按败血症处理，并与家属共同决策、并行计划姑息治疗。
conclusion.en: An 18-hour-old term boy (38 weeks, caesarean, 3.08 kg) was admitted because a cord-blood test taken for storage showed a very high white count. He looked well (36.8 °C, pulse 128/min, RR 36/min) but was pale, with a firm liver 4 cm and spleen 1.5 cm below the costal margin. White cells were 513.62 × 10⁹/L with 95 % immature lymphoid cells and platelets 94 × 10⁹/L, then 556.94 × 10⁹/L. Marrow (91 %, POX negative) and flow cytometry (CD19, cCD79a, CD34, HLA-DR) gave congenital B-lymphoblastic leukaemia; the karyotype and a limited RT-PCR panel were negative. Petechiae, an unbiopsied lumbosacral nodule, fever and reduced responsiveness followed; the family withdrew treatment on day 9 and he died at 45 days. Today: tumour-lysis prevention from the first hours (BSH 2015), KMT2A testing, an infant protocol at an experienced centre with honest odds (about one in five event-free for ALL from birth), fever treated as sepsis, and a shared decision with palliative care planned in parallel.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 外观良好的新生儿，白细胞超过500×10⁹/L且以原幼淋巴细胞为主，伴肝脾肿大和血小板减少，在证明是别的病之前都按白血病处理；类白血病反应、暂时性异常骨髓造血和计数误差都解释不了这张涂片。
keyReasoning.en: A newborn who looks well but has white cells above 500 × 10⁹/L, mostly immature lymphoid cells, with an enlarged liver and spleen and low platelets, has leukaemia until shown otherwise; a leukaemoid reaction, transient abnormal myelopoiesis or an analyser artefact cannot explain this film.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这个计数本身就是急症：确诊结果出来之前就要预防肿瘤溶解，而输红细胞、提前用激素和计划外腰穿是看似合理的陷阱。
keyReasoning.en: The count itself is the emergency: tumour-lysis prevention cannot wait for the confirming results, and red cells, early steroids and an unplanned lumbar puncture are the plausible traps.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CD19加cCD79a确定B系；POX阴性、CD34和HLA-DR并不意味着髓系或混合表型。真正没解决的是遗传学：正常核型和有限的RT-PCR排除不了KMT2A重排。
keyReasoning.en: CD19 with cCD79a decides B lineage; a negative POX, CD34 and HLA-DR do not make it myeloid or mixed. The open question is genetic: a normal karyotype and a limited RT-PCR cannot exclude KMT2A rearrangement.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 1岁以下（他只有几天大）加上极高白细胞，已经是需要婴儿方案和经验中心的高危疾病；KMT2A结果会进一步细化风险，告诉家属的机会应当是他所属群体的（约五分之一），而不是全体婴儿的平均数。
keyReasoning.en: Being under 1 year old (he is days old) with an extreme count already makes this high-risk disease that needs an infant protocol at an experienced centre; the KMT2A result refines the risk, and the odds given to the family must be his group's — about one in five — not the all-infant average.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 白血病新生儿出现发热、反应变差和出血点，在证明不是之前，先按败血症和颅内出血处理，而不是归因于肿瘤热。
keyReasoning.en: Fever, reduced responsiveness and petechiae in a newborn with leukaemia are sepsis and intracranial bleeding until shown otherwise, not tumour fever.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 报告中的死亡发生在家属放弃治疗之后：它既不能衡量现代治疗，也不能代表一个在充分知情下作出的决定。
keyReasoning.en: The report's death followed the family's withdrawal of treatment: it measures neither modern therapy nor a decision made with full information.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2011年发表的单例报告，不能用来比较治疗方法，也不能据此判断婴儿白血病的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；报告没有记录住院期间的治疗和死因，病例也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2011: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis for infant leukaemia. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; no treatment during the admission and no cause of death are recorded, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院血常规的血红蛋白、中性粒细胞和涂片的其余描述；第2天以后的任何血常规。
unknowns.en: The haemoglobin, neutrophil count and the rest of the admission count and film; any blood count after day 2.

unknowns.zh-CN: 电解质、尿酸、肌酐、乳酸脱氢酶、凝血功能和G6PD结果。
unknowns.en: Electrolytes, urate, creatinine, LDH, clotting and the G6PD result.

unknowns.zh-CN: CD10、髓系和T系标记的结果；KMT2A状态（没有FISH或RNA检测记录）以及多重RT-PCR覆盖的融合基因。
unknowns.en: CD10 and the myeloid and T-cell markers; the KMT2A status (no FISH or RNA-based test is recorded) and the fusions the multiplex RT-PCR covered.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑脊液检查（中枢神经系统状态）和任何影像学检查。
unknowns.en: A CSF examination (CNS status) and any imaging.

unknowns.zh-CN: 住院期间（至第9天）给了哪些治疗（补液、控制尿酸、输血、抗生素、化疗）。
unknowns.en: What treatment he received during the admission, up to day 9 (fluids, uric-acid control, transfusion, antibiotics, chemotherapy).

unknowns.zh-CN: 腰骶部结节的性质（未做活检）；低热和反应变差的原因；血培养结果。
unknowns.en: What the lumbosacral nodule was (not biopsied); the cause of the fever and the reduced responsiveness; any blood culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 阿氏评分、产检和唐氏筛查、母亲孕期感染、喂养、出生后用药（维生素K）和疫苗接种（含卡介苗）。
unknowns.en: Apgar scores, antenatal and Down's screening, infection in pregnancy, feeding, medicines since birth (vitamin K) and vaccines (including BCG).

unknowns.zh-CN: 家属放弃治疗的理由、出院后的照护和生后45天时的死因。
unknowns.en: The family's reasons for withdrawing treatment, his care after discharge and the cause of death at 45 days of life.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别：外观良好的新生儿也可能患白血病。本例白细胞513.62×10⁹/L、原幼淋巴细胞95%、肝肋下4 cm、脾肋下1.5 cm、血小板94×10⁹/L。新生儿白血病综述（Roberts等，Br J Haematol 2018）指出最常见的遗传学改变是KMT2A::AFF1，鉴别要点是类白血病反应（成熟中性粒细胞为主）、唐氏综合征的暂时性异常骨髓造血（髓系原始细胞）和有核红细胞造成的计数误差。按WHO第5版（2022），系别由免疫分型确定。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition: a newborn who looks well can have leukaemia. Here white cells were 513.62 × 10⁹/L with 95 % immature lymphoid cells, the liver 4 cm and the spleen 1.5 cm below the costal margin, platelets 94 × 10⁹/L. The review of neonatal leukaemia (Roberts et al., Br J Haematol 2018) names KMT2A::AFF1 as the commonest genetic change; the mimics are a leukaemoid reaction (maturing neutrophils), the transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down's syndrome (myeloid blasts) and nucleated red cells counted as white cells. Under the WHO 5th edition (2022), immunophenotyping sets the lineage.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 最初几小时（BSH 2015肿瘤溶解指南）：白细胞≥100×10⁹/L的急性淋巴细胞白血病属高危。不含钾的充分水化在儿童约3 L/m²/天（体重≤10 kg时约200 mL/kg/天），但在生后头几天，新生儿团队从新生儿自身的需要量起始、逐步加量，并监测体重、血钠和尿量；G6PD结果出来前用别嘌醇，排除G6PD缺乏后才可用拉布立酶（0.2 mg/kg）；每4–6小时复查电解质，记出入量。红细胞只在实测需要时小量缓慢输注（BSH 2016）；换血或白细胞单采留给有白细胞淤滞表现者。本病例没有记录当年做了哪些支持治疗。
teachingPoints.en: The first hours (BSH 2015 tumour-lysis guideline): ALL with white cells ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L is high risk. Potassium-free hyperhydration is about 3 L/m²/day in children (about 200 mL/kg/day at ≤ 10 kg), but in the first days of life the neonatal team starts from a newborn's own requirement and steps up, checking weight, sodium and urine output; allopurinol until a G6PD result is known, rasburicase (0.2 mg/kg) only once G6PD deficiency is excluded; electrolytes every 4–6 hours with a fluid balance. Red cells only for a measured need, slowly and in small volumes (BSH 2016); exchange transfusion or leukapheresis for signs of leukostasis. This case does not record what supportive care was given at the time.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分型：CD19加cCD79a确定B系；POX阴性不等于髓系，CD34和HLA-DR不定系别（WHO第5版，2022）。2011年的报告只做了核型和有限的多重RT-PCR；现在婴儿急性淋巴细胞白血病必须查KMT2A（分离探针FISH，必要时RNA方法），并完整报告CD10——CD10阴性的pro-B表型常与KMT2A重排相伴。
teachingPoints.en: Classification: CD19 with cCD79a sets B lineage; a negative POX does not mean myeloid, and CD34 and HLA-DR set no lineage (WHO 5th edition, 2022). The 2011 report had a karyotype and a limited multiplex RT-PCR; today infant ALL needs KMT2A testing (break-apart FISH, with an RNA-based method where needed) and a full panel including CD10 — a CD10-negative pro-B phenotype often goes with KMT2A rearrangement.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗与预后：婴儿急性淋巴细胞白血病在有经验的中心按婴儿方案治疗。Interfant-06（Pieters等，J Clin Oncol 2019，651例）全组6年无事件生存46.1%、总生存58.2%，但高危组（KMT2A重排、年龄<6个月，且白细胞≥300×10⁹/L或泼尼松反应不良）只有20.9%——他若有KMT2A重排即属此组；生后1个月内诊断的急性淋巴细胞白血病按Interfant-99治疗，2年无事件生存20%、复发更多，作者仍认为应以治愈为目标治疗（van der Linden等，Blood 2009）。全组数字只作背景；这例报告中的死亡发生在家属放弃治疗之后，不能用来说明现代治疗无效。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment and outlook: infant ALL is treated on an infant protocol at an experienced centre. In Interfant-06 (Pieters et al., J Clin Oncol 2019; 651 infants) 6-year event-free survival was 46.1 % and overall survival 58.2 % for all infants, but EFS was 20.9 % in the high-risk group (KMT2A-rearranged, under 6 months, with white cells ≥ 300 × 10⁹/L or a poor prednisone response), where he belongs if KMT2A-rearranged; ALL diagnosed in the first month of life had a 2-year EFS of 20 % on Interfant-99, with more relapse, and curative treatment was still judged justified (van der Linden et al., Blood 2009). The all-infant figures are context only; the death in this report followed the family's withdrawal of treatment and says nothing about modern therapy.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 与家属沟通：用SPIKES（Baile等，Oncologist 2000）告知坏消息；BAPM 2025围产期姑息治疗框架主张在结局不确定时为家庭提供全面支持、让父母参与决定、并行计划、控制症状。报告只记录了家属第9天放弃治疗，没有记录谈话内容和他们的理由——复盘时讨论的是怎样让这样的决定建立在充分信息之上。
teachingPoints.en: Talking with the family: SPIKES (Baile et al., Oncologist 2000) for breaking bad news; the BAPM 2025 perinatal palliative-care framework asks for holistic family support, parents empowered in decisions, parallel planning and symptom management when the outcome is uncertain. The report records only that the family withdrew treatment on day 9, not what they were told or why — the debrief is about how such a decision can rest on full information.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 病情变化：NICE NG195（2021，2024年更新）要求新生儿疑似感染时在决定治疗后1小时内开始静脉抗生素，先留血培养，腰穿只在安全时进行。本例住院后出现出血点、第4天腰骶部结节（未活检），之后低热、反应变差：要同时排查败血症、颅内出血和白细胞淤滞，床旁头颅超声不用搬动他。
teachingPoints.en: Deterioration: NICE NG195 (2021, updated 2024) asks for IV antibiotics within 1 hour of deciding to treat a suspected neonatal infection, after a blood culture, with a lumbar puncture only when it is safe. Here petechiae, a lumbosacral nodule on day 4 (not biopsied), then fever and reduced responsiveness call for a search for sepsis, intracranial bleeding and leukostasis together — and a bedside cranial ultrasound needs no move.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院血常规的血红蛋白、中性粒细胞和涂片的其余描述；第2天以后的任何血常规。
unknowns.en: The haemoglobin, neutrophil count and the rest of the admission count and film; any blood count after day 2.

unknowns.zh-CN: 电解质、尿酸、肌酐、乳酸脱氢酶、凝血功能和G6PD结果。
unknowns.en: Electrolytes, urate, creatinine, LDH, clotting and the G6PD result.

unknowns.zh-CN: CD10、髓系和T系标记的结果；KMT2A状态（没有FISH或RNA检测记录）以及多重RT-PCR覆盖的融合基因。
unknowns.en: CD10 and the myeloid and T-cell markers; the KMT2A status (no FISH or RNA-based test is recorded) and the fusions the multiplex RT-PCR covered.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑脊液检查（中枢神经系统状态）和任何影像学检查。
unknowns.en: A CSF examination (CNS status) and any imaging.

unknowns.zh-CN: 住院期间（至第9天）给了哪些治疗（补液、控制尿酸、输血、抗生素、化疗）。
unknowns.en: What treatment he received during the admission, up to day 9 (fluids, uric-acid control, transfusion, antibiotics, chemotherapy).

unknowns.zh-CN: 腰骶部结节的性质（未做活检）；低热和反应变差的原因；血培养结果。
unknowns.en: What the lumbosacral nodule was (not biopsied); the cause of the fever and the reduced responsiveness; any blood culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 阿氏评分、产检和唐氏筛查、母亲孕期感染、喂养、出生后用药（维生素K）和疫苗接种（含卡介苗）。
unknowns.en: Apgar scores, antenatal and Down's screening, infection in pregnancy, feeding, medicines since birth (vitamin K) and vaccines (including BCG).

unknowns.zh-CN: 家属放弃治疗的理由、出院后的照护和生后45天时的死因。
unknowns.en: The family's reasons for withdrawing treatment, his care after discharge and the cause of death at 45 days of life.
